Rate and pricing:
- Committed 8B tier: $0.00018 per token (volume-discounted).
- Committed 12B tier: $0.00016 per token for incremental usage above 8B.
- Burst-credit conversion: credit at your historic burst rate (no penalty).

Operational notes:
- Rate limits: we will raise your token/sec quota for the 8B/12B tiers; soft-throttle window will be 60s ramp with an automated fallback to your current hosted tier if errors exceed 5% for 5m.
- Auto-scaling: we'll schedule dedicated burst nodes during your promoted windows to reduce cold-start latency.
